_comment: 17.10.2026 (VAPT hardening). TEMPLATE - no secret belongs in appsettings.json. Every value below marked ENV is set as a machine environment variable (deploy/Set-ProductionSecrets.ps1); ASP.NET Core reads ConnectionStrings__JobCardScannerDb as ConnectionStrings:JobCardScannerDb. Keep only non-secret settings in the real file.

ConnectionStrings.JobCardScannerDb: ENV  ConnectionStrings__JobCardScannerDb  - use a LIMITED SQL login (read/write on JobCardScanner only), not the RDS 'admin' login
ConnectionStrings.CareDeskDb: ENV  ConnectionStrings__CareDeskDb  - a separate limited login for the CareDesk database

AzureAdGraph.ClientSecret: ENV  AzureAdGraph__ClientSecret  (rotate: it appeared in chat and in the repository)

CustomerPortalJwt.Secret: ENV  CustomerPortalJwt__Secret  (new random 64+ characters; rotating signs every customer out)

DealerAuthJwt.Secret: ENV  DealerAuthJwt__Secret  (new random 64+ characters; rotating signs every dealer user out)

BaplImport.DefaultDealerPassword: REMOVE - a shared, known first password ('Dealer@123') is itself a finding; the import should generate a random one per user

_security_note: Go-live order: deploy with RouteGuardMode and DealerScopeMode = LogOnly, use the site for one working day, read the log lines starting 'Route guard:' and 'Tenant isolation:' (a legitimate action listed there needs a rule change), then set both to Enforce (Security__RouteGuardMode=Enforce). Also set SessionFreshnessMode = LogOnly for that first day (log lines 'Session freshness:' show which sessions it WOULD end - a role / dealer mismatch for a normal user means the token and the database disagree and needs a look), then Enforce. Token lifetime is now 60 minutes (DealerAuthJwt / CustomerPortalJwt ExpiryMinutes, and MaxTokenMinutes caps any older token); the web and Android apps renew it silently, so deploy them together with the API. Switch CspMode to Enforce only after the browser console shows no 'Content Security Policy' violations on the main screens.
